scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @workspace/calora run test && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run test && pnpm --filter @workspace/scripts run test
scripts.test:ci: pnpm --filter @workspace/calora run test:ci && pnpm --filter @workspace/calora run test:release:native-preflight-unit && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run test:offline && pnpm --filter @workspace/scripts run test && pnpm --filter @workspace/fatsecret-gateway run typecheck && pnpm --filter @workspace/fatsecret-gateway run test
